notes.title: BIG NEWS: Circle Empires 2 - Coming Whenever!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're back, and we’re taking things full circle! Today, Luminous and Iceberg Interactive are thrilled to announce that we've been working on Circle Empires 2!

Check out the reveal trailer here:

[previewyoutube=TeruSM_eeWo;full][/previewyoutube]
This direct sequel is set to make the indie hit even bigger and better than before. We've kept the approachable and straightforward feel that made the original game so unique, which has always been the heart of the franchise.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3093020/Circle_Empires_2/

For returning players: CE2 is built from the ground up with a brand-new core structure, unlocking features that weren't possible in the past. You'll have more control over terrain and building placements, allowing you to fine-tune your defense strategies and optimize your economy. Units can now push each other, creating exciting group-on-group battles in key areas that you can influence with your positioning, magic units, and defensive setups. Plus, you can have any unit ride another, as long as it's large enough—so yes, you can use a dragon as a mount for a worker if you want! There's so much more to explore.

For new players: CE2 is an easy-to-learn strategy game where you conquer, build, and defend small kingdoms in a variety of dynamic scenarios. Engage in intense, dramatic battles, manage your regions wisely, and figure out the best strategies to dominate every challenge. Start with easier levels and work your way up to mastering the Impossible.

Circle Empires 2 takes everything you loved about the original and adds even more depth, variety, and fun. We've introduced new units, weapons, and terrain effects to keep the gameplay fresh and exciting. Plus, there's a brand-new mounting system where any unit can ride a larger one—so if you want to put a necromancer on a dragon, go ahead!

As we continue to develop the game, we’ll need playtesters to help us fine-tune everything. Be sure to wishlist Circle Empires 2 so you don’t miss your chance to test the game early!


Connect with us to stay up to date!

notes.title: Major Technical Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 


Circle Empires Tactics has received a major technical update. 

We have switched the service provider from Improbable to Amazon Gamelift. A lot has changed under the hood. The update should now be live and up and running. 

This change has taken place because Improbable shut down its game server branch.

There are small changes to starting a new multiplayer game. When creating a new lobby, players now choose between co-op and pvp mode, set the name for the lobby, and can optionally set a password. These settings can not be updated once the lobby has been created due to limitations on Gamelift.

If you find any strange issues related to multiplayer, please let us know on Discord or our other social media channels!

notes.title: Circle Empires Tactics Pathing Update!
notes.content:
Hello Commanders!

We're back with another small but important update. Some of you have been irked by unit pathing, especially in single-player. One issue was that units could waste an entire turn if your target moved out of its space, wasting your turns. With this update, units will chase after their targets if they move away, provided they have movement left.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202656/cd4a7f88d3911bc4d997a85161aebe1b13a9dbfb.gif

Second, units will remember last turn's orders. If their target is still alive after a turn, you won't have to give them new orders!

Give the new update a try and let us know your thoughts.

notes.title: Circle Empires Tactics Balance Update!
notes.content:
Dear commanders!

Thank you for the feedback you've given to us since launch! We've made some exciting changes to Circle Empires Tactics in this new patch, including single-player balance, unit unlocking, and tutorialization. 

Single Player Rebalance
The biggest change coming with this patch is the way the single player game mode is balanced. In the previous system, the world would scale with your performance, ensuring that every battle would pose a challenge in its own way. We've changed this to a more static overworld difficulty that will reward commanders for playing well, and vice versa. You can now 'catch up' with the power of enemy circles, while also risk falling behind the power curve if you don't manage your resources well.

We'd recommend playing around with the different difficulty settings and see what works best for you in the new system!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202656/4c6698e94eb1a769d3d0495940bafb596ddf20a1.gif

Tutorial
We've moved the tutorial to a separate instance you can load up whenever you start a single player game. This makes it easier for new players to learn the basics, while also not annoying veteran commanders when they start a new game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202656/b3b47397a08994439da9ebcad78fce291a939e94.png

Other Changes

Increased default game speeds from 1x to 2x in singleplayer and from 0.5 to 1 in multiplayer
1st Monsterhunt has more interesting overworld layout and features quest givers
Area Of Effect token is available in shop, but more expensive, so it's something to work towards
Area of Effect token can no longer be received as reward from collecting stars
Reduced max opponent creatures in regular battle from 25 to 10
Battles with special victory condition are 2x more rare
Made easy difficulty harder to reduce cap between easy and normal
AI no longer gains any "caster gains health" tokens
AI would never have more than 1 cast of health potion
Retrying battle would use the same seed, derived from worldcircle.x and y, so the unit placement does not change and makes it less of a dice roll to retry battles
Make second zone on the first map not a treasure zone
Lower quest giver circle strength bonus from 8x to 6x strength compared to regular circle at that distance.
Reduced strength of the semi-random extra strength circles that popped up every 2-3 circles from 3x to 2 in start area and from 2x to 1.5x in other areas
Reduced area guard strength bonus
Removed strength bonus for final boss because it was too strong when it was far away
Numerous fixes and clarity improvements

And that's the list for today's patch. Give the new single player a try and let us know what you think, commanders!

notes.title: Circle Empires Open Beta During Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Sharpen your swords, ready the horses, because the Circle Empires Tactics Open Beta is here! From today until the 28th of February, you can show your tactical superiority on our circular battlefields.

[previewyoutube=MFioHC2dyp8;full][/previewyoutube]
The Open Beta will give you a good glimpse of what the full game will have to offer, both in singleplayer and multiplayer. Unlike the previous beta period, this time all three factions are playable! Issue command of the mighty Orc army to trample your enemies, or play mind games with your opponent by mastering the magical Wizards. Returning players will also recognize the good ol' Human empire with their powerful, varied army. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202656/b2fcf30ec301692504df0c527c372c441663c646.gif

The single player mode of Circle Empires Tactics pits you against increasingly powerful enemies. Gather tokens to make your creatures more powerful, and combine them to make crazy combos! Manage your gold carefully, both in-battle and on the overworld map as you hunt down evil boss monsters. 

Multiplayer gets rid of the overworld and puts you straight into the action. The key to victory is predicting your opponent's moves, and planning accordingly. Will they move their cavalry to a nearby gold mine, or will they charge your archers? Every decision counts.

Open Beta Tournament!

We're holding a tournament in honor of our Open Beta. All you need to do to participate is... well, play! After a few days, we will invite the top 8 players on the multiplayer leaderboards to the tournament proper, which will be organized on our Discord. The top 8 players will receive a key for the full game, so make sure you climb those leaderboards!

The ultimate winner of the tournament will have their name permanently etched into the halls of glory! (Which is a fancy way of saying: an in-game hall of fame)

notes.title: Pre-Release Tournament — Show Your Tactical Skill!
notes.content:
Greetings commanders!

Happy New Year! We hope you've had a relaxing holiday season to end 2021. As we're getting closer to Circle Empires Tactics' release later this year, we're holding a little pre-release tournament!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202656/50cd066df28274400b7c7dabdb818e2242d8d7eb.png

The tournament starts on Friday January 14th at 19:00 CET, and the prize is unlimited glory and honor. Since the game hasn't even released yet, we're testing the waters for Circle Empires Tactics tournaments moving forward.

How do I enter?
"If the game isn't released, how do I enter the tournament?" you might ask. Well, you can get a testing key on our Discord by typing /key in the #key-channel. After that, just drop your Steam ID in the #tournament-signup channel.

What are the rules?

 1v1 matches
 Best of 3
 Double elimination (losing knocks you into loser's bracket. Losing in loser's bracket means you're out)
 Either defeat the enemy leader, or have more gold total than the opponent on turn 35 to win
 Maps are chosen by tournament organizers.


Simple enough, right? Join us and show your mettle on the battlefield! (mettlefield?)

And if you miss out on this one, don't worry! We'd like to do more tournaments in the future.

notes.title: Circle Empires Tactics OPEN Alpha Now Available!
notes.content:
Greetings commanders!

First, thank you for your feedback during our demo period, we're glad so many of you enjoyed yourselves! That brings us to some very exciting news: Circle Empires Tactics' Open Alpha is now... well, open! To celebrate, we've created a brand new trailer.

[previewyoutube=-0QXW5ug6eQ;full][/previewyoutube]

How do I join?
Very simple! 

[olist]
Go to the Circle Empires Tactics Steam store page
Scroll down a bit and click the 'Play Now' button (note: it may say 'Request Access' instead, just click that!)
Success! You should automatically gain access to the Alpha on Steam
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202656/5dafe6392fc788fae7dfa237a022189be5028c07.jpg

What's in the Alpha?
There's a lot more content in the Open Alpha than in the demo. Perhaps most notably: multiplayer! That's right, you can already play against others. It really drives the 'predict' part of Circle Empires Tactics home, so make sure to give it a try!

There's also the more fleshed out single player mode that will have you conquering many circles while customizing and upgrading your troops with randomly dropped tokens. The randomness of upgrade tokens gives this mode a lot of replayability that we know you'll enjoy.

And last but not least, the Alpha will contain all three playable factions! They play quite differently from the Empire faction. Take a look and find your favorite playstyle!

Sales!
That's not the only news we've got for you. If you're new to the world of Circle Empires, we've got two other awesome games on Steam! Circle Empires and Circle Empires Rivals are now 66% and 50% off respectively during the Iceberg Interactive Publisher Sale!

Check them out, as well as other Iceberg Interactive titles (up to 90% off!)

notes.title: Circle Empires Tactics - Gamescom Demo out now!
notes.content:
Important!

The demo was available for the duration of Gamescom, which has now ended. Don't worry if you missed out! There will be other opportunities to test the game out in the future. To stay up to date on that, join us on Discord, or keep an eye on our Steam and social pages.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202656/66256ed5a46672fee40b16be075a49ba63112022.jpg



Commanders!

We're very excited to share our first publicly playable demo with you in honor of Gamescom 2021! As the third installment of the Circle Empires franchise, we've mixed things up quite a bit from our earlier titles.

Before we get into the nitty gritty of the new demo, let's take a quick look at Circle Empires as a whole. We've made a short video showing how far we've come from our humble beginnings in 2016.

[previewyoutube=wU355PMRRYo;full][/previewyoutube]
For those of you who have played earlier Circle Empires games, the first thing you'll notice is the all-new character models! Gone (but not forgotten) are our beloved 2D warriors, mages, dragons, and more -- all hail the new dimension.

Just about every unit and spell in the game is customizable through these tokens, so go wild and experiment.

notes.title: Circle Empires Tactics coming in 2022!
notes.content:
Hail noble emperors and mighty warriors.

It is our distinct pleasure to show you the upcoming entry in the Circle Empires universe: Circle Empires Tactics!

In case you missed the reveal during Iceberg Ahead, fear not, we have the teaser trailer right here for you.

[previewyoutube=QdRpOs-cf28;full][/previewyoutube]

Circle Empires Tactics will offer a fresh spin on the Circle Empires series you know and love. CE Tactics is a simultaneous turn-based strategy game in which you will have to predict your opponent's moves, plan your own moves to counter them, then end the turn and watch the chaos unfold.

Features

 Play three story-based single-player campaigns focused on Circle Empires’ ruling factions and uncover a gripping story where not everything is as it seems. 
 Level up your leader and gain new skills allowing you to implement different strategies throughout the campaign
 Play with your friends in multiplayer co-op or challenge them for a game in PvP mode 
 Each faction has a variety of units and creatures, all with their own special abilities and traits, offering a dynamic playstyle and making every battle unique. 
 Choose the difficulty level that fits your experience (or ego), ranging from a new recruit to being a descendant of Sun Tzu. Circle Empires Tactics offers a wide range of difficulty levels for both single-player and co-op.
 Did you play through all the campaigns? Or are you looking for a new challenge? Then have a go at the map editor and create your own scenario. Share it with friends via Steam Workshop. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35983334/82dbf35247dd0ed78acaaad93dcc70ef553539a2.png

The release of Circle Empires Tactics is still a ways away, but make sure you wishlist the game on Steam to stay up to date on the latest news!
